name: BokehDiff public inference Track A preparation, shared supplied geometry
conditioning: [d, abs(d-focus)*K/10]; raw supplied disparity, no per-frame min-max, no focus shifts
basis: Public TestDataset blb path preserves 1/depth and supplied focus; public inference_hf uses abs(defocus_strength)*K*upsample/10. This is an external-input adapter, not recovery of Any-to-Bokeh's private adapter.
RGB: sRGB PNG8/255 -> 2*RGB-1; no GT-dependent brightness adjustment
model: RealVisXL_V5.0 + author BokehDiff small LoRA and VAE
seed_policy: Reset global torch RNG and the pipeline generator to 0 for every frame; public PISA draws from global torch.rand. No seed search.
output: Public log_validation quantization (uint8 truncation), save lossless PNG instead of demo JPEG
limits: K/10 preserves the public conditioning convention, not a proof of exact rendered blur radius or equivalence to the benchmark renderer.
PISA uses disparity for occlusion as well as defocus magnitude; changing its coordinate range would not be an innocuous CoC-only transformation.
Native PISA divides by 1-d; inspect d=1 behavior and finite output without silently clamping supplied disparity.
Capacity/keyframe checks do not establish full temporal quality or freeze the final adapter.
